description: Only creates an invoice for the human to pay. It does not move sats and does not spend the credit balance. Put the QR image and the QR URL in your own message. Pay from any Lightning app. Do not paste the invoice. Pass include_invoice only when the human asks. Pass awaiting_buy only when a buy is waiting.

accept_terms.description: Optional. When this covers the current terms, the account stores that acceptance. The invoice still does not move sats.

awaiting_buy.description: Default false. Set true only when a buy is waiting on this payment.

include_invoice.description: Default false. Set true only when the human asks for the raw invoice, or the QR and links cannot be used.

name: top_up

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Top up
